cases.sentence: Пойди и купи у горшечника глиняный ___.
cases.translation: Go and buy a clay jar from the potter.
cases.explain: Direct object of купи (buy) requires accusative case.

cases.sentence: Возьми с собой кого-нибудь из старейшин народа и из старейшин ___, и выйди в долину.
cases.translation: Take some of the elders of the people and of the priests, and go out to the valley.
cases.explain: Genitive plural indicates 'elders of the priests' category.

cases.sentence: Я нашлю беду, от которой у любого, кто слышит, зазвенит в ___.
cases.translation: I will bring such a disaster that the ears of all who hear will tingle.
cases.explain: Preposition в (in) with location requires prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Люди осквернили эту землю и жгли благовония чужим богам, которых не знали ни цари ___.
cases.translation: Men defiled this land and burned incense to other gods unknown to the kings of Judah.
cases.explain: Possessive genitive цари Иудеи (kings of Judah).

cases.sentence: Я отдам их трупы в пищу небесным птицам и земным ___.
cases.translation: I will give their corpses as food to the birds of the sky and beasts of the earth.
cases.explain: Dative indicates the recipients of food (в пищу).

cases.sentence: Я разобью этот народ, как был разбит кувшин горшечника, который уже не ___.
cases.translation: I will break this people like a potter's jar that cannot be repaired.
cases.explain: Infinitive in the phrase уже не склеить (can no longer be repaired).

cases.sentence: Я оскверню этот город, как осквернен ___, дома Иерусалима и дворцы царей.
cases.translation: I will make this city like Topheth, the houses of Jerusalem and palaces of the kings.
cases.explain: Predicate nominative in the comparison structure.

cases.sentence: Иеремия встал во дворе Господнего дома и возвестил всему ___.
cases.translation: Jeremiah stood in the courtyard and announced to all the people.
cases.explain: Indirect object of возвестил (announced) requires dative case.

reading.ru: Так сказал Господь. «Пойди и купи у горшечника глиняный кувшин. Возьми с собой кого-нибудь из старейшин и выйди в долину Бенгеном.»
reading.question: What did the Lord command?
options: Buy a clay jar and take elders to the Valley of Ben Hinnom
Build an altar in the marketplace
Gather all the people at the temple
Make an offering to the king
reading.correct: Buy a clay jar and take elders to the Valley of Ben Hinnom
reading.explain: Clear divine instruction for symbolic prophetic action.

reading.ru: Я нашлю на эту землю беду, от которой у любого, кто слышит, зазвенит в ушах.
reading.question: What will be the nature of the coming disaster?
options: Such a disaster that hearing of it will shock people
reading.correct: Such a disaster that hearing of it will shock people
reading.explain: Disaster so great it causes physical shock to hear of it.

reading.ru: Люди осквернили эту землю и жгли благовония чужим богам, которых не знали.
reading.question: What sins have the people committed?
options: Defiled the land and burned incense to unknown gods
reading.correct: Defiled the land and burned incense to unknown gods

reading.ru: Я разобью этот народ и этот город, как был разбит кувшин горшечника, который уже не склеить.
reading.question: What does this comparison illustrate?
options: The destruction will be permanent and irreparable
reading.correct: The destruction will be permanent and irreparable
reading.explain: The broken jar symbolizes permanent destruction.

reading.ru: Я накормлю его жителей плотью их сыновей и дочерей в осаде и нужде.
reading.question: What horror will befall the people?
options: During siege, they will eat their own children
They will be blessed with plenty
reading.correct: During siege, they will eat their own children
reading.explain: Describes the extremity of famine during siege.

reading.ru: Все дома, где на крышах жгли благовония чужим богам, будут осквернены, как место Тофет.
reading.question: What will be the fate of idolatrous houses?
options: They will become as unclean as Topheth
reading.correct: They will become as unclean as Topheth
reading.explain: Topheth (place of Moloch worship) becomes their fate.
